fields.description: Address Frappe Cloud hands to Suite sites so they can reach this Suite Cloud, e.g. https://cloud.frappemail.com. Leave blank to use this site's own URL.
fields.label: Public URL

fields.description: Every request from a Suite site runs as this user. It is created on install and needs no changes.
fields.label: Site Service User
Server Job Timeout (Seconds)
fields.description: How long an install, bootstrap or upgrade job may run before it is marked failed. Bootstrapping the first node includes waiting for a certificate, so keep this generous. 1800 = 30 minutes.
Stalwart release that new clusters install, e.g. v0.16.20. Existing clusters keep their own version until you run Upgrade Nodes on them.
fields.label: Stalwart Version

fields.description: Where the node downloads the Stalwart archive from. {version} is replaced with the release and {target} with the platform, e.g. x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.
fields.label: Stalwart Download URL Template
Stalwart CLI Version
fields.description: Release of stalwart-cli installed next to the server, e.g. v1.0.12. Only used on a node while it bootstraps a cluster.

fields.label: Stalwart CLI Download URL Template
fields.description: Where the node downloads the stalwart-cli archive from. Same placeholders as the server URL.

Certificate authority clusters request their TLS certificates from. While testing use https://acme-staging-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory to avoid rate limits; staging certificates are not trusted by mail clients.
fields.label: ACME Directory URL

fields.description: Address the certificate authority writes to about expiring certificates. Used by clusters that do not set their own contact.
fields.label: ACME Contact Email

fields.description: How long resolvers may cache the records Suite Cloud publishes, used when a DNS Zone sets no TTL of its own. Also suggested to sites for their domain records. 300 keeps node changes quick to roll out.
fields.label: Default DNS TTL (Seconds)
